description: Implementation of the CordRepRing class managing a ring buffer for string representations in the Abseil library, including methods for buffer management, subring creation, and validation.

classes.name: CordRepRing
classes.description: A class implementing a ring buffer for string representations, supporting operations like append, prepend, subring, and validation.

methods.name: AddDataOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the data offset for a specific entry in the ring.

methods.name: SubLength
methods.description: Subtracts length from the end position of a specific entry.

methods.name: CreateFromLeaf
methods.description: Creates a ring buffer from a leaf node with specified offset and length.

methods.name: CreateSlow
methods.description: Creates a ring buffer from a complex CordRep, handling different node types.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ring buffer from a CordRep, dispatching based on node type.

methods.name: AddRing
methods.description: Adds a subring to the current ring, either appending or prepending.

methods.name: AppendSlow
methods.description: Appends a CordRep to the ring, handling non-flat nodes.

methods.name: AppendLeaf
methods.description: Appends a leaf node to the ring.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a CordRep to the ring, dispatching based on node type.

methods.name: PrependSlow
methods.description: Prepends a CordRep to the ring, handling non-flat nodes.

methods.name: PrependLeaf
methods.description: Prepends a leaf node to the ring.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends a CordRep to the ring, dispatching based on node type.

methods.name: GetAppendBuffer
methods.description: Provides a buffer for appending data directly to the ring.

methods.name: GetPrependBuffer
methods.description: Provides a buffer for prepending data directly to the ring.

methods.name: SubRing
methods.description: Creates a subring representing a portion of the current ring.

methods.name: RemovePrefix
methods.description: Removes a prefix of specified length from the ring.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix of specified length from the ring.

methods.name: FindBinary
methods.description: Performs a binary search to find the position for a given offset.

methods.name: FindSlow
methods.description: Finds the position in the ring for a given offset using binary and linear search.

methods.name: FindTailSlow
methods.description: Finds the tail position for a given offset.

methods.name: GetCharacter
methods.description: Retrieves a character at a specific offset in the ring.
